methodologyNotes: Roster covers ten verified tower-fan models, all independently re-confirmed against manufacturer/official-channel pages (Dreo, Lasko, Dyson, Vornado, Honeywell Store, Pelonis, Levoit/VeSync, Holmes) and corroborated by major-retailer listings (Amazon, Target, Walmart, Best Buy, Sylvane) on 2026-06-20. Comfort Zone CZTSR8 and Sharper Image SBT2-M remain excluded (no verifiable official spec pages for those exact model numbers). priceUsd reflects published MSRP or lowest confirmed official-channel list price; where only a street retail price exists, that figure is used and noted in priceNote. 'bladeless' is true when the manufacturer or its official retailer describes an enclosed-fan-wheel/impeller design or Dyson Air Multiplier; false for visible open-blade cages. Noise figures are manufacturer-stated dB where the maker publishes them; for Honeywell HYF290B the 39 dB figure is from an independent review (Honeywell does not publish a dB spec) and for Vornado OSCR37 the 44 dB figure is from Sylvane (Vornado does not publish a dB spec). Corrections this pass: Levoit Classic 36 releaseDate 2024->2023 (PR Newswire launch Apr 2023); Holmes source URL path fixed to the live /fans/tower-fans/ path. accessedAt 2026-06-20.

products.name: Dreo Cruiser Pro T1 Tower Fan
products.provenance: Re-verified directly from the official Dreo product page: $99.99, 41.73 in (13x13x41.73), 6 speeds, 90° oscillation, 12h timer, 34–48 dB. Dreo/retailers market it as bladeless (enclosed fan wheel). All draft values confirmed unchanged.

products.name: Dreo Nomad One Tower Fan
products.provenance: Re-verified from official Dreo page: $79.99, 36.22 in, 4 speeds, 90° oscillation, 8h timer, 20 dB, remote included. The Dreo page itself does not use the word 'bladeless' (it uses a full-length impeller); Walmart/Amazon official listings market it as bladeless, so bladeless=true retained per methodology. All numeric draft values confirmed.
